verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows Seer or any Sentry feature acting as an MCP client. The agent-tracing docs only cover observing tool calls made by users' own agents, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
